answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 31915 Country: India Title: Plz tell me can we spread our legs in infront of Parents. Plz guide me. Question: Plz tell me can we spread our legs in infront of Parents. Plz guide me. Answer ID: 31915 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 717/595/B=1432) It is disrespect to stretch one's legs in front of elders. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
